properties.name: raillens.admin.api-key
properties.description: LEGACY shared secret in the X-Admin-Key header (see raillens.admin.legacy-key-enabled). Replaced by admin accounts with MFA. Fails closed if blank.

properties.name: raillens.jwt.secret
properties.description: HS256 signing secret for access JWTs (see JwtService). Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32`. Local dev only in the gitignored application.properties; rotate before any non-local deployment.

properties.name: raillens.jwt.expiration-minutes
properties.description: How long an issued access JWT stays valid, in minutes, before a client must exchange its refresh token for a new one (see AuthService/RefreshTokenService).

properties.name: raillens.jwt.refresh-expiration-days
properties.description: How long an issued refresh token stays valid, in days, before it's rejected regardless of revocation status (see RefreshTokenService.issue).

properties.name: raillens.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated list of origins allowed to make cross-origin requests to /api/** (see WebConfig). Defaults to the local frontend dev origin only.

properties.name: raillens.client-ip.trusted-proxies
properties.description: Comma-separated CIDR ranges of reverse proxies whose forwarding headers are trusted for client-IP resolution. Defaults to loopback and private ranges.

properties.name: raillens.client-ip.trusted-header
properties.description: Optional single-value header carrying the client IP, set by a CDN in front of the trusted proxy (on Render: True-Client-IP). Only read when the request arrives from a trusted proxy.

properties.name: raillens.auth.refresh-reuse-grace-seconds
properties.description: Seconds after a refresh-token rotation during which re-presenting the old token is treated as a concurrent refresh (rejected) rather than theft (whole family revoked).

properties.name: raillens.admin.legacy-key-enabled
properties.description: Transition switch for the shared X-Admin-Key. true (default): still accepted, with a warning logged on each use. false: any request carrying the header is refused; admins sign in with their own account + MFA.

properties.name: raillens.admin.bootstrap-usernames
properties.description: Comma-separated existing usernames promoted to ADMIN at startup (promotion only, never demotes). Requires raillens.mfa.encryption-key.

properties.name: raillens.mfa.encryption-key
properties.description: Base64 of 32 random bytes (openssl rand -base64 32): AES-256-GCM key for TOTP secrets at rest. Required for admin sign-in. Changing it invalidates every enrolled authenticator.

properties.name: raillens.mfa.enrolment-token-minutes
properties.description: Lifetime of the single-purpose token an admin without MFA receives at sign-in to enrol an authenticator.

properties.name: raillens.jwt.admin-expiration-minutes
properties.description: Lifetime of admin (MFA) access tokens. Bounds how long a demotion or a stolen admin token stays effective.

properties.name: raillens.auth.mfa-session-hours
properties.description: Absolute lifetime of an MFA (admin) session from sign-in; refreshing does not extend it.

properties.name: raillens.client-ip.proxy-secret
properties.description: Shared secret (32+ characters) that lets the RailLens website's own server pass the visitor's IP in X-RailLens-Client-IP (it signs people in on their behalf, Phase 2B). Must equal RAILLENS_PROXY_SECRET on Vercel. Blank: the header is ignored.

properties.name: raillens.railops.jwks-url
properties.description: RailOps login's public keys (e.g. https://railops-identity.onrender.com/.well-known/jwks.json). When set, RailOps access tokens are accepted alongside RailLens' own (single login, Phase 4B). Blank: off.

properties.name: raillens.railops.issuer
properties.description: Exact issuer RailOps puts in its tokens (its JWT_ISSUER, on Render the identity service's URL). Required when raillens.railops.jwks-url is set.
